description: Per-round commit watermark for the Scind <-> Xcind cross-project sync. The LAST entry in rounds[] is the baseline the NEXT round starts from. Read this first in Step 2 of engineering/maintenance/cross-project-sync.md; append to it in Step 6. The recorded range SCOPES a round (which files can possibly have moved); the correspondence-map diff still DECIDES the round's work.

xcind.comparison_surface: engineering/ (eng-docs), backed by as-built bin/ + lib/xcind/

scind.comparison_surface: engineering/ (was docs/ before scinddev/scind#5; see the path alias in the procedure)

field_notes.reviewed_through: The last commit whose CONTENT the round's correspondence map and ledger actually reflect. Deliberately not HEAD: commits that landed after the map was rebuilt belong in known_excluded, not here.
field_notes.known_excluded: Commits inside the round's calendar window that the round did NOT triage, each with a reason. The next round must treat these as unreviewed input.
field_notes.round_outputs: Commits the round itself produced. Already accounted for in canon or in the ledger; exclude them from the next round's triage.

xcind.reviewed_through_subject: Scind<->Xcind sync: P6 reconciliation + P7 divergence registry (#81)
round_outputs: 80f083a  feat(host-gateway): expose XCIND_HOST_GATEWAY inside containers (resolves divergence 0022)
dbbc397  fix(workspace): app config cannot rename the discovered workspace
e8a8d2d  test(completion): behavioral tests for every completion function (evidence for RL-112)
c7358b4  docs(specs): document the XCIND_CACHE_SCHEMA SHA input
ffee906  docs(decisions): ADR-0005 flavors deferral + ADR-0023 targeting deviation
known_excluded: 5b4b9f4  #83  External proxy mode: serve apps through an existing host Traefik (ADR-0022)
a5f9494  #87  Add resolve-specific help to xcind-config
92b0ea5  #88  fix(config): refresh resolved compose cache after GENERATE hooks
xcind.known_excluded_reason: Feature work that landed 2026-07-28..2026-08-05, after the P2 correspondence map was built at 9f975e4 and while the escalation follow-up was in flight. Never triaged against canon. This is round 2's primary input, and Step 1's self-sync gate is NOT green for it: the P1 self-sync report predates every one of these commits.

scind.compared_against_note: Canon as it stood when the P2 map was built (the base commit of PR #3).
scind.canon_at_close_note: main after this round's four PRs merged. Round 2 diffs from here.
prs: https://github.com/scinddev/scind/pull/7  merged 2026-08-07 as ca156eb  (RL-112 scind-compose binary)
scind.note: Every Scind commit between 5f6ae25 and ca156eb is this round's own output. Round 2 therefore has no unaccounted canon-side drift and runs one-directionally: new Xcind as-built -> canon.

next_round_diff.scind: git -C /home/dev/Code/scind fetch origin && git -C /home/dev/Code/scind log --oneline ca156eb..origin/main
next_round_diff.note: Subtract round_outputs from the xcind range; what remains is known_excluded plus anything newer. The scind range is expected to be empty until canon moves independently.

xcind.head_at_close_note: Plus this round's own docs(sync) bookkeeping commit, which lands immediately after this entry is written; it is a round output.
round_outputs: docs(sync) round-2 bookkeeping commit (ledger round-2, map refresh, registry stamps + 0034 closure, report, this baseline entry)
xcind.known_excluded_reason: Nothing: every commit in 9f975e4..ce0da4c is either a round-1 output (already accounted) or was triaged this round.

prs: https://github.com/scinddev/scind/pull/8  OPEN at close (round-2 batch: ADR-0017 external proxy mode, proxy destroy, app get, +16 more rows)
